Filed at `docs/ref/VAST_DEEP_GROK_SERVERLESS.md` (companion to `VAST_API_EXPERT_REFERENCE.md`). Sources are official docs fetched 2026-08-27, not a live marketplace probe.

**Serverless.** Same $/hr as ordinary instances, billed per second, no surcharge. GPU compute is free while Creating/Inactive; **storage still bills on cold workers**. First boot 3–5 min; Inactive (model already loaded) wakes in seconds. OpenAI drop-in: `https://openai.vast.ai/<ENDPOINT_NAME>` with your Vast key — chat + completions only. Scale knobs: `min_workers` 5, `max_workers` 16, `min_load` 1, `target_util` 0.9, `cold_mult` 3, queue 30s/10s. GUI defaults ≠ API defaults.

**Volumes.** Local to one physical machine. Host list default **$0.10/GB/month**. No snapshot product — clone (`vastai clone volume`) is a one-shot copy. Serverless workers that hop hosts will not see the disk.

**Reserved.** Not AWS RI. Prepay onto an **existing on-demand instance**. Default curve **20% / 1 mo, 30% / 3 mo, 40% / 6 mo** ($720 → $576 at $1/hr). Marketing says 50%; API schema caps `discount_rate` at 0.4. Credits locked to that host. Early cancel: claw back the discount + **5%**. **Stopping releases the GPU.**

**Host.** Separate account. Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, Pascal+, 4 GB RAM/GPU, 128 GB SSD/GPU, 3 ports/GPU. Payouts: Wise/PayPal/Stripe, **$20 min**, invoices **Fridays**, first pay ~2 weeks. Closest official cut: client prices **~25% above host earn**. Vast’s May 2026 snapshot: 5090 **$0.30–$0.60/GPU-hr** host-side; H100/H200 **$2.15–$4.00+**.

**Templates.** Docker-run wrappers. `--public` puts them in search. Money is **3% lifetime referral of spend**, not a per-launch royalty. Pin serverless workergroups to `template_hash`.
